# Visit California

> > Official tourism website for California, operated by the California Travel and Tourism Commission, featuring travel guides, hidden destinations, and tourism industry governance.

Visit California serves as the official destination marketing organization for California tourism, providing comprehensive travel information while also managing board governance and industry initiatives through the California Travel and Tourism Commission.

## Key Topics

- California tourism destinations
- California Travel and Tourism Commission
- Hidden and secret attractions
- Speakeasy and cocktail bars
- Commissioner referendum and board elections
- Tourism industry governance
- California nightlife experiences
- Hospitality industry partnerships
- Travel planning resources
- Tourism assessment programs
- Board member selection process
- Destination marketing
- California travel experiences

## Hidden Gems & Secret Destinations

- [10 Hidden Speakeasy Bars in California](https://www.visitcalifornia.com/experience/6-secret-california-bars/): Guide to hidden speakeasy bars from San Diego to San Francisco

## Optional

- [2026 Commissioner Referendum](https://vote.visitcalifornia.com/): California Travel & Tourism Commission 2026 board election voting portal
- [2026 Commissioner Referendum Research](https://vote.visitcalifornia.com/research): Research page for 2026 Commissioner Referendum candidates and process
